settings.text: An innovative global brand that embodies a creative lifestyle, combining the realms of work and play like never before.

settings.title: OWN YOUR SIT
settings.description: The Athena Series allows you to personalize your comfort. Choose from our premium signature leatherette or fabric upholstery, offering you the option of sleek sophistication or cozy elegance. Your chair, your way.

settings.title: DURABLE, BREATHABLE, SOFT
settings.description: Engineered for intense gaming marathons, our fabric is lab tested for 100,000 cycles to ensure the surface and color stays vibrant. The thickness is precisely calibrated down to millimeters to deliver the ideal balance of softness and suppor.

settings.title:
LUXURY.

ENDURANCE.

SUSTAINABILITY

ALL IN ONE
settings.description: Experience the perfect fusion of luxury and durability with our sustainable leatherette. Delivering the premium feel of NAPA leather, it boasts 15 times the strength of standard PU, ensuring long-lasting performance while helping protect the planet.

settings.title:
SOFT YET SUPPORTIVE –

THE PERFECT BALANCE
settings.description: Why settle for stiff, uncomfortable foam when our upgraded ultra-soft memory foam offers superior softness and lasting resilience? It cradles you in cloud-like comfort while providing the perfect support, designed to keep you comfortable, focused, and supported for years to come.

settings.title:
Upright or Reclined,

We’ve Got You Covered
settings.description: Engineered for every posture—whether upright, cross-legged, reclined, or leaning—our wider, more versatile seat base provides adaptive comfort that supports you in any position.

settings.title: SGS CERTIFIED, MORE DURABILITY
settings.description: Now featuring KGS factory gas lifts, SGS certified, and offering up to class 4 pressure. With top-tier materials and exceptional performance in load support, drop, rotation, and impact tests, it’s built for long-lasting durability.

settings.title: Adjustable Lumbar Support
settings.description: The lumbar support is the heart of any great gaming chair, and ours is exceptional. With adjustable height and depth, it ensures a perfect fit for your spine, delivering ultimate comfort and support. The backrest is enhanced with memory foam, offering even more softness and comfort while providing superior support for long gaming sessions.

settings.title:
PRECISE ARM SUPPORT RELIEVE

SHOULDER & ARM STRESS
settings.description: Our 4-Way Dynamic Armrests are engineered to support your natural posture, moving seamlessly in every direction to reduce stress on your muscles and joints. These armrests provide the perfect alignment to keep you supported and comfortable.

ADJUST WITH EASE

settings.heading: 1. How do I track my order?
settings.content: Once your order ships, you'll receive a shipping confirmation email and tracking number, so you can follow your package as it makes its way to you. However, tracking information can take up to 24 hours to update, so don’t worry if it doesn't show up immediately. We recommend tracking your order and ensuring that you’re home on the day of delivery to receive your order.

settings.heading: 2. When Will My Order be Shipped?
settings.content: Inventory orders are typically shipped the next business day and will be delivered within 1-5 business days.  For more information, please check our Shipping and Return Policy.

settings.heading: 3. My order has been shipped. Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.content: Unfortunately, we’re unable to cancel your order once it ships.

settings.heading: 4. Can I exchange my Order？
settings.content: For the most efficient resolution to obtain the item you desire, we recommend returning the original item. Once your return is approved, we encourage you to proceed with a separate purchase for the new item.  For more information, please check our Return & Refund Policy.

settings.heading: 5. How will my order be delivered?
settings.content: We deliver your order straight to your address via DHL & GLS. You’ll receive an email with a tracking number when your order ships, so you can easily track your order. Please ensure that you’re home on the day of delivery to receive your order.

settings.heading: 6. What do I do if I face an issue with my purchase?
settings.content: In the unlikely event that you come across any damaged, defective or missing parts, please contact us at support@blacklyte.com with a photo of the affected area and your order number. Our support specialists will do their best to assist you.
